brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack that hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 2x hex-acc-keyhole on piece:0,0,0 slot1 and piece:2,0,0 slot1 (accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#2,0#1) – rear faces for wall screws
3x hex-acc-hook hook plates on front faces (accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4, accessory:0#2,0#4) – each provides two hooks, total 6 hooks across 3-cell rack

finish.summary: 3-cell linear rack with keyhole hangers on rear for wall mounting and three hook plates on front for hand tools. Capped open ends and locked joints. Props for tools not displayed as wall hooks require elevation to hang clear of bench, but physical hook hardware is installed.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
